facts.subject: main/melee/it/kinds/itmariofireball:it_8029B6F8
facts.value: Mario's neutral-special release callback consumes its one-shot throw event, computes world coordinates from Mario's left-hand joint, and passes the fighter object, those coordinates, `It_Kind_Mario_Fire`, and fighter facing into this routine. The routine copies the coordinates into `SpawnItem.prev_pos` with Z set to zero, derives `SpawnItem.pos` through the parent-position helper, records zero initial damage and velocity, assigns both parent references, and requests item creation. The resulting item is then given attribute-derived launch speed, angle, and lifetime, entered into motion state 0, associated with the originating fighter, and passed through common item setup.
facts.reason: Local SpawnItem flow is supported; throw-event and left-hand joint caller claims were not independently read.
